verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Crude spike lifts tanker rates over refiners
cells.refutation: If the tanker basket does not outperform the refiner basket from open t+1 to close t+5, or if the effect appears equally in integrated majors, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Tanker basket should outperform refiner basket; effect should be concentrated in tanker names with high spot exposure, not integrated majors.

cells.title: Treasury yield shock lifts rate-sensitive insurers
cells.refutation: If the insurer basket does not outperform vol-matched sector controls from open t+1 to close t+5, or if the effect appears equally in non-rate-sensitive financials, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Insurer basket should outperform sector-matched controls; effect should be concentrated in life insurers with long-duration liabilities, not broad financials.

cells.title: Co-mentioned peers react to clinical trial failure
cells.refutation: If linked peers' residual return is not more negative than unlinked vol-matched peers (t < 1), the read-through is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Linked peers' next-session residual return should be more negative than vol-matched unlinked biotech peers.
